question.problem: Which of the following describes the level surfaces of the function $f(x,y,z)=\frac{1}{\sqrt{{z}^{2}-{x}^{2}-{y}^{2}}}?$
question.worked_solution:
The level surfaces of the function $f(x,y,z)$ are given by the following equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(x,y,z) & =c \\ \frac{1}{\sqrt{{z}^{2}-{x}^{2}-{y}^{2}}} & =c \\ \frac{1}{{z}^{2}-{x}^{2}-{y}^{2}} & ={c}^{2} \\ {c}^{2}{z}^{2}-{c}^{2}{x}^{2}-{c}^{2}{y}^{2} & =1 \\ {c}^{2}{x}^{2}+{c}^{2}{y}^{2}-{c}^{2}{z}^{2} & =-1\end{aligned}
$$

Notice that $f(x,y,z)$ can't be zero or negative. Therefore, we get a family of hyperboloids of two sheets:

$$
{c}^{2}{x}^{2}+{c}^{2}{y}^{2}-{c}^{2}{z}^{2}=-1,\,c\in (0,\infty ).
$$

choices.value: A family of hyperboloids of two sheets: ${c}^{2}{x}^{2}+{c}^{2}{y}^{2}-{c}^{2}{z}^{2}=-1$
A family of hyperboloids of one sheet: ${c}^{2}{x}^{2}+{c}^{2}{y}^{2}-{c}^{2}{z}^{2}=1$

responses.value: A family of hyperboloids of one sheet: ${c}^{2}{x}^{2}+{c}^{2}{y}^{2}-{c}^{2}{z}^{2}=1$
